description: VoteZWebb Zyaire Webb is a candidate for NC House District 10. He is bringing power back to the people. His primary focus is a 20/20 vision for North Carolinians, that means a 20K pay raise for all teachers and a $20 minimum wage. "A working Man for the people not above but equal."
title: VoteZWebb | NC House District 10 | Goldsboro, NC, USA
